_comment: Snapshot of the ESPHome web_server event format the B2500 web UI parses. See scripts/check-web-server-contract.mjs. requiredKeys is hand-maintained: the fields the web UI actually reads. alsoAccepted holds set_json_id() bodies that differ from the baseline but were read and found to emit the same id, each with the reasoning; add one with --accept, never by hand.

alsoAccepted.note: set_json_id() takes JsonObject by value and casts id_buf to const char* at the assignment (esphome/esphome f946615). Neither touches the bytes written: the id is still {domain}/{device}/{name}, or {domain}/{name} without USE_DEVICES, which parseStorageEntity() splits on '/' as before (issue #317).

Only the DETAIL_ALL fields changed: domain, name and device are now set through json::linked() and icon through json_table_str(), which store a pointer to the same string (ArduinoJson JsonString isStatic=true) instead of copying it, so the serialized bytes are identical. The id assignment is unchanged from the accepted dev variant of 2026-09-19 -- still static_cast<const char *>(id_buf) holding {domain}/{device}/{name}, or {domain}/{name} without USE_DEVICES -- which parseStorageEntity() splits on '/' as before (issue #324).

The entity name is no longer memcpy'd from get_name() but written into id_buf by obj->write_name_to(), which copies the same name_ bytes (the entity's own name, or the device/friendly-name fallback as before) and null-terminates them; it only bounds the copy to the room left in id_buf, which a name within the 120-char limit never reaches (esphome/esphome#20423, names kept in flash on ESP8266). icon now goes through linked(get_icon_progmem()), the same string read in place (esphome/esphome#21111). The id assignment is unchanged -- static_cast<const char *>(id_buf) holding {domain}/{device}/{name}, or {domain}/{name} without USE_DEVICES -- which parseStorageEntity() splits on '/' as before (issue #326).
